nodes.summary: For a Motzkin Riordan pair $(g, h)$ and natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the $(n, k)$ entry is the rational number $[X^n]\, g h^k$, the coefficient of $X^n$ in the power series $g h^k \in \mathbb{Q}[[X]]$.
nodes.title: Entries of a Motzkin Riordan array

nodes.summary: Formal power series $g, h \in \mathbb{Q}[[X]]$ form a Motzkin Riordan pair when there is a power series $s \in \mathbb{Q}[[X]]$ with $s^2 = 1 - 2X - 3X^2$ and constant coefficient $1$ such that $g s = 1$ and $2 X h = 1 - X - s$.
nodes.title: Motzkin Riordan pairs

nodes.summary: A formal power series $s \in \mathbb{Q}[[X]]$ is a Motzkin square root when $s^2 = 1 - 2X - 3X^2$ and the constant coefficient of $s$ is $1$.
nodes.title: Square roots of the Motzkin discriminant

nodes.summary: The Motzkin discriminant is the formal power series $1 - 2X - 3X^2 \in \mathbb{Q}[[X]]$, the discriminant in the generating functions for the Motzkin triangle.
nodes.title: Motzkin discriminant

nodes.summary: Let $s = \sum_{n \ge 0} \binom{1/2}{n} (-2X - 3X^2)^n \in \mathbb{Q}[[X]]$ be the canonical square root of $1 - 2X - 3X^2$, which has constant coefficient $1$. The power series $g \in \mathbb{Q}[[X]]$ is the multiplicative inverse $g = s^{-1}$ of $s$, that is, $g = 1/\sqrt{1 - 2X - 3X^2}$.
nodes.title: First component of the Motzkin Riordan pair

nodes.summary: Let $s = \sum_{n \ge 0} \binom{1/2}{n} (-2X - 3X^2)^n \in \mathbb{Q}[[X]]$ be the canonical square root of $1 - 2X - 3X^2$. The power series $h \in \mathbb{Q}[[X]]$ has $n$-th coefficient $\frac{1}{2} [X^{n+1}] (1 - X - s)$ for every $n \ge 0$. Since $1 - X - s$ has constant coefficient $0$, this is the quotient $h = (1 - X - s)/(2X)$.
nodes.title: Second component of the Motzkin Riordan pair

nodes.summary: Let $s \in \mathbb{Q}[[X]]$ be the canonical square root of $1 - 2X - 3X^2$, given by the binomial series, which has constant coefficient $1$. The canonical Motzkin Riordan pair is $(g, h)$ with $g = s^{-1}$ and $h = (1 - X - s)/(2X)$, the Motzkin Riordan pair conditions being witnessed by $s$.
nodes.title: The canonical Motzkin Riordan pair

nodes.summary: A bundled Motzkin Riordan pair consists of formal power series $g, h \in \mathbb{Q}[[X]]$ together with a proof that they form a Motzkin Riordan pair: there is $s \in \mathbb{Q}[[X]]$ with $s^2 = 1 - 2X - 3X^2$ and constant coefficient $1$ such that $g s = 1$ and $2 X h = 1 - X - s$.
nodes.title: Bundled Motzkin Riordan pairs

nodes.summary: The canonical square root is the power series $s = \sum_{n \ge 0} \binom{1/2}{n} (-2X - 3X^2)^n \in \mathbb{Q}[[X]]$, obtained by substituting $-2X - 3X^2$ for $Y$ in the binomial series $(1 + Y)^{1/2} = \sum_{n \ge 0} \binom{1/2}{n} Y^n$.
nodes.title: Canonical square root of the Motzkin discriminant

nodes.summary: Writing $T(n, k)$ for the $(n, k)$ entry of the canonical Motzkin triangle, the rows $n = 0, 1, 2, 3$ (with $0 \le k \le n$) are $T(0, 0) = 1$; $T(1, 0) = T(1, 1) = 1$; $T(2, 0) = 3$, $T(2, 1) = 2$, $T(2, 2) = 1$; and $T(3, 0) = 7$, $T(3, 1) = 6$, $T(3, 2) = 3$, $T(3, 3) = 1$, matching OEIS A094531.
nodes.title: Initial rows of the Motzkin triangle

nodes.summary: Let $s$ be the square root of $1 - 2X - 3X^2$ in the ring of formal power series over $\mathbb{Q}$ with constant coefficient $1$, and let $g = 1/s$ and $h = (1 - X - s)/(2X)$. For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the $(n, k)$ entry of the Motzkin triangle (OEIS A094531) is the rational number given by the coefficient of $X^n$ in $g h^k$.
nodes.title: Motzkin triangle

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
